tasks.//test: --node-modules-dir=none: ignore the legacy node_modules/ (Node-era, dropped in Phase 3) so Deno doesn't try to auto-resolve @types/node during type-check.
tasks.//build: deno compile recipe — each flag = a bug we already solved (see _PLAN + memory talos-deno-single-exe). NO --self-extracting: the exe ships on a SHARED OneDrive launched by N machines, so the native lib must NOT extract beside the exe; server.ts reads the embedded lib bytes and writes them to a per-machine LOCAL dir (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Talos) before dlopen (see memory talos-shared-exe-local-extraction). --no-terminal: GUI, no console (replaces Start.vbs). --allow-all: perms BAKED at compile (else silent NotCapable). --minimum-dependency-age 0: pty-ffi 0.40.0 too young for the guard (drop when it ages). Targets: mac-arm64 + win-x64 ONLY (mac-x64/linux deferred — see _PLAN).
tasks.//dist:bundles: Copy bundles/ NEXT TO the exe — NOT --include'd into it. The exe is a generic engine; the bundles are the integrator's content, read from the real disk beside the exe at runtime (see BUNDLES_DIR in server.ts). This makes the build produce a KIT (exe + bundles/), the exact shape a team drops on the shared OneDrive. Runs in deno_task_shell's built-in cp/rm → same command works on the macOS AND Windows CI runners.
tasks.build:mac: deno compile --target aarch64-apple-darwin --allow-all --unstable-ffi --minimum-dependency-age 0 --exclude node_modules --include public --include native/libpty_arm64.dylib --output dist/talos-mac-arm64 src/server.ts && deno task dist:bundles
tasks.build:win: deno compile --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --icon native/talos.ico --no-terminal --allow-all --unstable-ffi --minimum-dependency-age 0 --exclude node_modules --include public --include native/pty.dll --output dist/talos.exe src/server.ts && deno task dist:bundles
tasks.//build:win-debug: SAME as build:win but WITHOUT --no-terminal → keeps a console so log() echoes live in PowerShell. Evidence-gathering build; not for distribution.
tasks.build:win-debug: deno compile --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --allow-all --unstable-ffi --minimum-dependency-age 0 --exclude node_modules --include public --include native/pty.dll --output dist/talos-debug.exe src/server.ts
